note: Paper A manuscript-facing CLAIMS CONTRACT (Paper 1 second review, MC1.4). One row per load-bearing value that appears in prose, tables, highlights or figure annotations. The phrase guard (tools/paper_a_consistency.py) checks WORDING; this contract checks the NUMBERS and the observable basis they are reported on. It exists because a curated phrase list cannot catch a stale figure: the venue conversion carried proxy-inclusive 22.6/23.1/19.9/25.2 while the canonical draft had already moved to named-solute 26.3/22.7/26.8/23.8/28.8, and every phrase check passed. Each row binds a value to its producer key in docs/figures/paper_a/results.json so a number can never be edited in prose alone.

observable_bases.named_solute: macro-average over the three NAMED solutes (caffeine, trigonelline, 5-CQA). The primary basis.
observable_bases.proxy_inclusive: named solutes POOLED with the source-specific aggregate-solids proxy (modelled TDS / gravimetric total solids / refractometer). Reported separately, NEVER as the headline -- the proxy is not an equivalent analyte.
observable_bases.not_applicable: value is not an analyte-basis quantity.

claims.retired_note: 22.6 was the proxy-inclusive figure used as a headline in an earlier conversion. It is not merely stale -- it is a DIFFERENT observable basis.
Secondary only. Must never be presented as the primary blind metric.
The refinement closes ~0.5 pp on EITHER basis; the basis must still be stated.

retired_labels.note: The comparators are non-nested and unequally flexible, so no likelihood-ratio reading applies. Applies to manuscript prose, figure titles AND claim labels -- the phrase guard checked only the two manuscript files, so the figure title and the build.py claim label escaped it.
